holderQuote: He looked at Ressa. She blinked up at him, and then bared her teeth.
effectQuote: She leapt at them and the [Assassins] dove away with a cry as a second, shadow-Ressa appeared and was skewered on the [Blademaster]’s sword. Tyrion Veltras accelerated.

holderQuote: But here was Luan. [Athlete]. Olympian from another world. The finest competitor you’d be able to meet in either one.
